Question: Triangle \(ABC\) has \(AB=13,\) \(BC=14,\) and \(AC=15.\) Let \(P\) be the point on \(\overline{AC}\) such that \(PC=10.\) There are exactly two points \(D\) and \(E\) on line \(BP\) such that quadrilaterals \(ABCD\) and \(ABCE\) are trapezoids. What is the distance \(DE?\)
